channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: Alpha Kappa Alpha chapter doubles goal, collects more than 600 pillows in “Stuff the Bus” drive
item.description: The Psi Xi Omega Chapter of Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Incorporated more than doubled its goal during its annual “Stuff the Bus” pillow drive, collecting over 600 pillows to benefit Sleep in Heavenly Peace.

item.title: Helena Huskies earn win over Spain Park Jaguars
item.description: The Helena Huskies hosted the Spain Park Jaguars on Friday, Feb. 20, and came away with a 2-1 victory, despite playing a man down for most of the second half.

item.title: How College Agriculture Clubs Are Driving Sustainability Movements
item.description: College campuses now act as lively spaces where new ideas take shape, especially those focused on sustainability.

item.title: Pelham wins all three Mobile Preseason Classic games against McGill, Elberta, Spanish Fort
item.description: Pelham rolled to a 3-0 record through opening weekend with a walk-off win over McGill-Toolen Catholic followed by a run-rule victory over Elberta and a dramatic road win at Spanish Fort.

item.title: Shelby County rallies past Saraland to start season 3-0
item.description: Shelby County is 3-0 to start the baseball season with an opening day win over Childersburg and a couple opportunistic wins over Orange Beach and Saraland at the Hank Aaron Classic.

item.title: Thompson finishes home tournament undefeated
item.description: Thompson rolled to wins over Oak Mountain, Chilton County, St. Clair County, Bibb County and Moody at the Thompson Invitational to start the season 5-0.

item.title: Oak Mountain claims Lakeshore Shootout Gold title with three shutouts
item.description: Oak Mountain stayed undefeated and won the Lakeshore Shootout Gold Division title with three clean sheets against Spain Park, Bob Jones and McGill-Toolen Catholic to continue the Eagles’ perfect defensive record.

item.title: From Pelham to the podium: Miss UNA Jada Winston has calling rooted in service, faith and home
item.description: Jada Winston, a veteran of pageants who recently won Miss University of North Alabama, continues to pour back into her hometown of Pelham by leading a life of faith and service.

item.title: Spain Park sweeps PBR Kickoff Classic games against Hartselle, American Christian
item.description: Spain Park walked off against Hartselle and dominated American Christian to beat a pair of defending state champions at the PBR Kickoff Classic.

item.title: Hendricks denied bond in Aniah's Law hearing following fatal shooting of girlfriend
item.description: Judge Lara Alvis has ruled that Noah Reed Hendricks will receive no bond following an Aniah's Law hearing
